subject: Geopolitics
title: Why Oil Shapes World Politics
description: A fast breakdown of Why Oil Shapes World Politics for builders.

hook.text: Oil powers armies, economies, and transportation. Control the oil and you control the pace of modern civilization.

buildup.text: Every major war since 1914 has involved oil: access to it, denial of it, or competition over it.

discovery.text: Oil is not evenly distributed. The Middle East holds half the world's proven reserves, giving the region outsized power.

twist.text: The US shale revolution changed the game. America went from oil importer to top producer in a decade.

climax.text: Oil remains the most geopolitically important commodity on Earth. Whoever produces, refines, or routes it wields power.

punchline.text: Oil isn't just energy. It's leverage.

quiz.question: Why does oil give the Middle East outsized geopolitical power?
options: It has the largest military forces in the world
It holds about half the world's proven oil reserves
It controls all global shipping lanes
